verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a bundle of Claude Code skills (SKILL.md prompts plus local standard-library Python scripts) that runs inside a host assistant and operates no service that could ingest data for training. Whether user data is used to train models is controlled by the host LLM platform, not by a prompt or skill pack, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product. The note that its scripts never touch the network is an adjacent property and does not change that.
